scripts.build: pnpm --filter shared build && pnpm --filter extension build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter extension test && pnpm --filter backend test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter extension typecheck && pnpm --filter backend typecheck
scripts.verify:all: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm verify:rls && pnpm verify:drop && pnpm verify && pnpm verify:ui && pnpm verify:docs
scripts.zip:store: AWA_STORE_BUILD=1 pnpm --filter shared build && AWA_STORE_BUILD=1 pnpm --filter extension zip
